generationInputs.prompt: A logo vintage 3D snark poster features a luminous pink donut, an eggplant, two bananas, and two chili peppers with syringes on a dark pink background. Two female legs, clad in black fishnet stockings and black high-heeled shoes, emerge from the donut's center. Two hands also extend from the donut, one holding a syringe with glowing liquid and the other holding a glass pipe. An eggplant is depicted with a syringe. One banana holds a bright syringe, and another banana is present alongside a red chili and a green chili. The overall impression is one of lightness and airiness, with a dreamlike, slightly otherworldly quality due to the holographic effect of the donut's icing. The dark pink background softly complements the donut's color, maintaining a feeling of delicate sweetness and ethereal beauty, all rendered in a vintage 3D snark poster style.
